text:
Platinum Price in 2008
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2008, the LBMA platinum price fell 48.1% between 2008-01-31 ($1,731) and 2008-12-30 ($898). The highest sampled price was $2,150 in February and the lowest was $814 in October. The mean of these observations was $1,563. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
What happened in 2008:
The global financial crisis drove waves of safe-haven demand into precious metals.
